_comments: Corrects the description of MJ: AI Prompts.FailoverStrategy to what the runners do (#4907).
The chat prompt runner only tells None apart from the other values: every non-None strategy
walks the candidates from model selection in priority order, which can include other models.
Cross-model failover is what keeps agents running during a provider outage, so the runner keeps
that behavior and the description is corrected instead. AutoUpdateDescription = 0 keeps CodeGen
from restoring the old text from the column comment.

fields.Description: Whether a failed model call fails over to other candidates. None: the selected model is called once, with no failover. Any other value (SameModelDifferentVendor, NextBestModel, PowerRank): after a failover-eligible error, the remaining candidates from model selection are tried in priority order, and they can include other models; the chat prompt runner does not tell these values apart. Only the embedding runner narrows by strategy: SameModelDifferentVendor keeps it on the selected model, so vectors stay in one space.
